statement.p: A local restaurant has two locations. At one location, the revenue this month is {\$89{,}000} but it has been decreasing by {\$4{,}500} per month. At the other location, the annual revenue this month is {\$43{,}000} and it has been increasing by {\$3{,}000} per month. How long will it be until the two restaurant locations are taking in the same monthly revenue? And what will that monthly revenue be?
